## Fatal findings

None.

## Nonfatal findings

None. The compressed coefficient-comparison, finite-prefix alignment, and shift-span arguments are routine moves within the 30-second threshold.

I found no false or overstrong title/Statement, unlicensed inference, missing hypothesis, inaccurate `[L#]` citation, or prohibited `ai-generated` dependency target in the seven items.

The reciprocity formulas were additionally tested across 13,608 recurrences over \(\mathbf F_2,\mathbf F_3,\mathbf F_5\), orders \(1\)–\(3\); the identity, endpoint formulas, zero case, and symmetry equivalence all passed.
